### **User description** ## Summary This PR completes the SemanticLogger migration by finishing Phase 3 (general-purpose middleware) and introducing monotonic timing support for duration measurements. All middleware now use structured logging with the HTTP category, and the application has a consistent API for measuring time intervals that's immune to system clock adjustments. ### Monotonic Timing Added `Onetime.now_in_μs` as a standardized way to measure durations using CLOCK_MONOTONIC. This replaces scattered uses of `Time.now` and `Process.clock_gettime` with a single, reliable API that delegates to `Familia.now_in_μs`: - Immune to NTP adjustments, DST changes, and manual clock modifications - Returns integer microseconds for precise measurements - Used in RequestLogger, SessionDebugger, and security specs - Renamed `duration_ms` to `duration` as part of standardizing on microseconds The monotonic clock is perfect for measuring request durations, timeouts, and performance profiling where you care about elapsed time, not wall clock time. ### Middleware Migration All general-purpose middleware in `lib/middleware/` now use the `Middleware::Logging` module: - **DetectHost** - Host detection with HTTP category - **HandleInvalidPercentEncoding** - URI validation with HTTP category - **HandleInvalidUTF8** - UTF-8 validation with HTTP category - **HeaderLoggerMiddleware** - Header debugging with HTTP category - **SessionDebugger** - Already using module, now with monotonic timing Enhanced `Middleware::Logging` to make `initialize_logger` and `infer_category` public so middleware can override the `logger` method while still getting automatic HTTP category inference. ### Logging System Cleanup Removed the workaround in `OT.l*` methods that routed calls without kwargs to legacy stdout/stderr formatting. Now ALL logging goes through SemanticLogger with consistent output format: - Migrated `lib/onetime/application/base.rb` to structured logging - Migrated `lib/onetime/application/middleware_stack.rb` to structured logging - Migrated `lib/onetime/middleware/domain_strategy.rb` to structured logging - Fixed SemanticLogger lazy loading to avoid initialization order issues ### Error Handling Enhancement Enhanced exception logging with SemanticLogger integration: - `lib/onetime/error_handler.rb` - Structured exception logging with context - `apps/web/core/middleware/error_handling.rb` - HTTP error logging with request context - `apps/web/core/controllers/base.rb` - Controller error patterns - Created `try/system/logging_exception_handling_try.rb` with 20 test cases ### Documentation Updates Updated `docs/logging-system-overview.md` and `docs/logging-migration-guide.md` to reflect Phase 3 completion and document the `ONETIME_DEBUG=1` flag that sets all application loggers to debug level. ## Testing All changes tested via: - `FAMILIA_DEBUG=0 bundle exec try --agent try/system/logging_exception_handling_try.rb` - 20 testcases passed - `FAMILIA_DEBUG=0 bundle exec try --agent try/system/logging_simple_try.rb` - 23 testcases passed - Security specs continue to pass with monotonic timing - Manual verification of middleware logging with `DEBUG_HTTP=1` ## Environment Variables The logging system now supports: ```bash # Enable debug logging for all application categories ONETIME_DEBUG=1 bundle exec puma # Enable debug for specific categories DEBUG_HTTP=1 bundle exec puma DEBUG_AUTH=1 DEBUG_SECRET=1 bundle exec puma # Fine-grained control DEBUG_LOGGERS=Auth:debug,HTTP:trace bundle exec puma ``` 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) Co-Authored-By: Claude ___ ### **PR Type** Enhancement, Bug fix ___ ### **Description** - Standardize duration measurements with monotonic timing via `Onetime.now_in_μs` - Migrate all general-purpose middleware to structured logging with HTTP category - Enhance exception logging with dedicated `exception:` parameter in `OT.le` - Remove legacy logging workaround, consolidate all output through SemanticLogger - Add `ONETIME_DEBUG=1` flag for global application debug logging ___ ### Diagram Walkthrough ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Legacy Logging
Process.clock_gettime"] -->|Migrate| B["Monotonic Timing
Onetime.now_in_μs"] C["Scattered Middleware
Raw Logger"] -->|Consolidate| D["Middleware::Logging
HTTP Category"] E["Multiple Log Calls
Exception Details"] -->|Simplify| F["Single Call
exception: parameter"] G["Workaround Path
stdout/stderr"] -->|Remove| H["SemanticLogger
All Paths"] B --> I["Structured Logging
Complete"] D --> I F --> I H --> I ```
